Send your choices to Cameron

1. Readable report

Send Cameron a readable list of your favourites, Lesley Highlights, maybes and notes. It includes only one entry for each merged experience.

2. Save a full backup

This JSON file protects all five choices, notes and Lesley Highlights, including older cards merged into one choice. Save a copy in Files or send it to Cameron before updating the app.

Restore a saved backup

3. Duplicate clean-up

The original card IDs and texts are kept in the master archive for old saved answers. Repeated experiences are only shown once.

If two old cards for the same place had different answers, the app will flag them for you to review rather than silently discarding either.

4. Print or start again

There is no automatic cloud sync. Keep your backup outside this device. App updates need the same HTTPS address to reuse saved answers.

R25 includes Lesley Highlights and safe on/off backup restoration with saved lists and backups. The full original R21 questionnaire and agreed itinerary are preserved in the master package. No new places or itinerary adjustments. Future dates, accessibility and opening hours still need checking before travel.
